Values 16/32/64/128/256 are all in streaming_forward's no-padding list, so no pre-target transformation changes Lk. The witness trigger Lk=17 is padded to 32 before _forward and therefore does not reach the assertion; the positive Lk=256 is the nearest directly-rejecting head size and Lk=128 is the largest accepted one.
